entries.en: ordinarily; constantly (Sp. 'or di naria mente~' = ordinariamente)
entries.notes: 西语栏为缩写（ordinaria mente＝ordinariamente）；汉字栏仅「恒」一字而闽音栏为两音节，第二音节在汉字栏无对应字。

entries.zh: 经常；屡屡（首字存疑：景/晷，闽音近「屡」，姑作「屡常、经常」解）
entries.en: frequently; usually (first character uncertain: 景/晷; the Hokkien reading rather suggests 屢 'repeatedly')
entries.notes: 汉字首字有[疑]标（景/晷），闽音栏首音节与两候选字皆不近而近「屡」，姑作「屡常/经常」解。

entries.zh: 仆仆（叠字）：奔走劳顿之貌〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: reduplicated 僕僕: 'wearily, toiling to and fro' (classical sense); sense unresolved against 'ordinarily'
entries.notes: 「仆仆」古典义为劳顿、奔走之貌，与西语栏 ordinariamente 义不合，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: paternal aunt (father's sister); the Spanish column ('ordinarily') does not match this Chinese gloss
entries.notes: 汉、闽两栏互证为「姑姑」（父之姐妹），但西语栏 ordinariamente 与之不合，条目对应关系存疑。

entries.zh: 再三再四；一而再、再而三
entries.en: again and again; time after time

entries.zh: 过过（叠字）：屡屡经过、经历〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: reduplicated 過過: conjecturally 'to pass through / experience repeatedly'; sense unresolved
entries.notes: 「过过」叠字与西语栏难以对应，「屡屡经过」系姑解。

entries.zh: 见可常（字面难解）：姑作「常见、习见」〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: 'commonly seen / as is usual' (conjectural; characters and reading unclear)
entries.notes: 三字与闽音栏三音节拼合不明，「常见、习见」系姑解，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 足足；整整（数量充足、不折不扣）
entries.en: fully; amply; no less than (a whole amount)
entries.notes: 西语栏为短语残片（ordinariamente viene a pedir…），与「足足」不直接对应，释义从汉、闽两栏。

entries.zh: 俗物；平常之物（古义亦指庸俗之人）
entries.en: a common or vulgar thing; (classical sense) a vulgar person

entries.zh: 俗套；俗例、惯常套数〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: set formula, conventional usage (Spanish and Hokkien columns damaged)
entries.notes: 西语栏残断（「como co…」未尽），闽音栏后段难解、疑杂入西语字样（numbre 类），释义据汉字「俗套」。

entries.en: ear (oreja, fem.); the organ of hearing (oír)
entries.notes: 闽音栏残缺（仅存首音），官话栏字样与「耳」不合、疑串行；释义据西语 Oreja/oir 与汉字「耳」。

entries.zh: 帽耳（帽檐两侧「耳」状部件，疑指官帽）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 'ear' of a hat, i.e. side flap, probably of a mandarin's hat; text damaged, gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 西语栏残断（「del man gathir~」难解，疑涉官帽 mandarín），闽音栏首字处原件污损难辨，汉字首字有[疑]（秧/映）。

entries.en: cavity of the heart ('the organs of the heart, by which it communicates')

entries.zh: 耳镜：指耳，听觉器官（「镜」字存疑）
entries.en: ear, organ of the sense of hearing (organos del sentido de oír); Chinese gloss literally 'ear-mirror', character possibly corrupt
entries.notes: 汉字「耳镜」字面与西语「听觉器官」义稍有出入，「镜」字或有讹误。

entries.zh: 教堂乐器（管风琴之类；汉字首字疑为「箫」）〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: the organ(s) &c. in the church, i.e. church organ/music; Chinese gloss unclear (first character probably 箫 'flute/pipe')
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑]标（硝/箫），闽音栏四音节与二字汉字不合；「箫」类乐器义与西语教堂 organos 相合，姑作此解。
